exam_scheme.note: ESIC recruits paramedical staff across 17 distinct healthcare cadres through a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT). The examination comprises 100 questions for a total of 150 marks with a duration of 120 minutes (2 hours). Technical Professional Domain Knowledge carries 50 questions for 100 marks (2 marks each), while General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning, and Arithmetic Ability carry 50 questions for 50 marks (1 mark each). Negative marking of 0.25 marks is applicable for each wrong answer. Final merit is prepared region-wise and cadre-wise strictly based on CBT performance.

financial_package.note: ESIC Paramedical personnel in core cadres (Pharmacist, Lab Tech, Radiographer) are appointed under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix at Level 5 (entry basic ₹29,200). In addition to standard central allowances (DA, HRA, Transport Allowance), staff serving in hospital wards and laboratories are eligible for Hospital Patient Care Allowance (HPCA) / Patient Care Allowance (PCA).
financial_package.pay_source_label: ESIC Paramedical Advt 2023: Pay Matrix Level 5 (₹29,200 – ₹92,300)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 5 Entry Basic ₹29,200 + 58% DA (₹16,936) + HRA (₹8,760 for Class X metro, ₹5,840 for Class Y) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688) + Hospital Patient Care Allowance (HPCA ~₹4,100/mo). Gross in Class X metro is ~₹64,684; in-hand is ~₹54,000–₹56,000 after 10% NPS deduction (₹4,614) and statutory taxes.
